published_text: Pay 12 M€ to receive this milestone, in addition to the normal claim cost of 8 M€ (so, 20 M€ total).
10 energy production and heat production combined.
1 production of each resource. (If you play without the Corporate Era, you need 2 production of each resource instead.)
3 tiles on, or adjacent to, volcanic areas (marked with bold text on the maps). If playing with a map without volcanic areas, replace this milestone.
Having placed 4 oceans. (Place owner markers on each ocean until claimed. This owner marker does not make the ocean tile yours, though.)
Having all your 7 delegates in parties (Party Leaders and Chairman also count).
2 of each standard resource (after paying the claim cost).
6 steel production and titanium production combined.
5 cards with non-negative VP. (Cards that count 1 VP per 2 microbes or similar cards also count.)
2 Earth tags, 2 Venus tags, and 2 Jovian tags.
16 cards in hand (when claiming this milestone).
Combined total production of at least 16. Not all types need to be represented, and negative M€ production subtracts from the total.
3 cards with a cost of 20 M€ or more.
Having raised temperature 5 times. (Mark with your player marker on the temperature track each time you raise temperature until claimed.)
3 different types of resources on cards.
Most cards with no tags (don’t forget the corporation and Prelude cards).
Highest TR. If you play with this Award, count it before all other Awards and Milestones!
Most bio tags combined (plant, microbe, and animal).
Most cards that have a cost of 20 M€ or more.
Most different types of resources, both on your player board and on your cards.
Most tiles adjacent to special tiles.
Most tiles not adjacent to ocean.
Most cards costing 10 M€ or less.
Most steel and energy resources combined.
Most tiles connected together (each player counts his/her largest group of tiles).
Highest production of steel and heat combined.
Having most steel and titanium resources combined.
Highest production of steel, titanium, plants, energy, and heat combined (all except M€ production).
Most Party Leaders and influence combined.
Most cards in your event pile.
Most tiles on areas along the edges of the map.
Most Jovian and Earth tags combined.
Most animal and microbe resources combined.
